text: I recall that the first things I ate were campfire and tent. This is the only food I ever consumed until my passing. In my mind, this meal remains the most satisfying. At the time, I must have been around five or six years old. I vividly remember the place where I found it. I can see it vividly in my mind's eye. It was the only food I was able to consume before my demise. This is the first time I have ever felt such nostalgia.
